STYLE: Illustration in exactly the style of the reference image: thin clean dark linework, soft flat colours with light cel shading, realistic proportions, muted palette, pure white background with lots of empty space, no thick cartoon outlines. The hero is the man from the reference (late twenties, short black hair, white shirt with rolled sleeves, navy waistcoat, burgundy tie, blank silver name tag); draw him exactly ONCE with exactly two arms and two hands. Any other person must look clearly different (no burgundy tie, no navy waistcoat). No text, no letters, no numbers, no labels, no arrows, no speech bubbles, no logos; no clocks unless the scene gives one with hand positions.
